reviewer: Independent second-pass visual review agent /root/haas_r04_review; did not author or edit asset

criteria.name: Window/opening placement, counts, rhythm, proportions, frames and glazing divisions
supported_features: East pavilion: three upper groups, each three columns by two rows; two flanking segmental lower openings, each two columns with three horizontal levels; central door and two basement windows. These counts match the clear front photographs.

West: nine upper groups and nine narrow middle openings; three upper groups at north/door end are triple lights and remaining six double lights. Eight basement windows plus the rear door. Broad rhythm supported by elevated 2016 photograph and 2026 street views.

North model has five main-body bays plus two pavilion-return arches; south repeats five plus two. These are model counts, not full source verification. East wings have three upper groups on each side; vegetation limits full confirmation.

deductions.reason: Unobstructed opening schedule is absent for south, pavilion returns and portions of east wings; branch-covered north bays also retain uncertainty. Repetition across these faces cannot receive full supported credit.

West basement window immediately south of rear door is visibly too wide/squat relative to the photographed near-square two-by-two opening. Upper paired openings also read broad and shallow relative to the close view; dimensions need perspective-matched checking rather than a common width schedule.

Rear door transom is too shallow in the saved model and retains a generic crossbar arrangement. Photo shows a substantially deeper gridded transom above the two door leaves. Confirm actual grid before remodeling.

criteria.name: Signature architecture: arches, entrances, columns and ornament
supported_features: Recessed narrow oak door, layered segmental portal, flanking keyed arches, quoined stone piers, paired lanterns, solid stair cheeks, north service door/alarm, rear light and camera are present and recognizable.

deductions.reason: Front frieze/plaque and upper pier reliefs remain mostly blank rectangular proxies. Photographs show incised/relief ornament and a richer molded stone composition. Do not invent unreadable lettering; obtain adequate detail or preserve explicit uncertainty.

Continuous stepped stone band above and around upper windows, including central crown blocks and small lower support blocks, is simplified to isolated rectangular frames plus thin strips; eave brackets are generic. This loses the characteristic linked cornice/window-head profile on both front and west.

Rear entry approach omits the photographed step run along the south retaining cheek; model is a simple channel with symmetrical cheeks. Front handrails also run along outer sides, whereas clear front photograph shows the paired central/offset rail arrangement. Verify and match both entry layouts within building boundary.

criteria.name: Overall proportions, wings/setbacks, roof form and silhouette
supported_features: Large hipped main block and lower projecting entrance pavilion are recognizable across elevations and obliques. GIS-derived wall outline supports wings/setbacks only; it earns no facade points.

deductions.reason: No measured height, calibrated elevation or true aerial/roof source verifies ridge heights, pavilion/main roof relationship or concealed roof junction. Elevated west photo supports broad hip silhouette but cannot verify entire roof.

Roof reads as an uninterrupted flat hip sheet without the photographed ridge/tile-edge profile and small rooftop penetrations visible in 2016 elevated source. Present-day survival of the small penetrations needs verification, so they are not declared definitely missing in 2026.

criteria.name: Material/color fidelity, surface scale, trim and facade depth
supported_features: Muted red brick, pale limestone, dark eaves, olive/bronze frames and honey oak door are in the correct broad material families. Both standard and daylight variants were inspected; exposure improvement is not treated as material accuracy.

deductions.reason: Roof procedural pattern reads as a mottled rectangular masonry grid rather than the clearly horizontal overlapping clay-tile courses in the elevated source; tile profile/relief is absent.

Glazing is uniformly opaque dark gray-green and the same frame treatment repeats on the basement and rear door. Photos show more distinct metallic rear-door framing, varied reflected glazing, and a stronger dark/light frame separation. Color is judged qualitatively because source images are uncalibrated.

Stone coursing, shallow ornament and brick variation remain overly uniform at close distance. Photographed limestone joints and projecting trim carry a more differentiated depth profile; exact colorimetry remains unverified.

criteria.name: Whole-building visual consistency across all elevations and matched oblique views
supported_features: All four principal model elevations, both supplied elevated obliques, roof, close details and four independent perspective views show a coherent saved revision. No geometry credit for hidden schematic interior or polygon/object counts.

deductions.reason: Source breadth is inadequate for whole-building acceptance: real evidence is concentrated at front and west with incomplete south/east-return coverage; a true aerial and several low/near return viewpoints are absent. Repeated views from one panorama are not independent positions.

Supplied review set is entirely orthographic and its obliques use camera height 38 m. Independent eye-level perspective views expose entry/depth discrepancies and remain approximate because reference camera calibration is unavailable.

uncertainties: All dimensions from photographs are proportional estimates, not surveyed measurements.
Source dates vary: 2016 elevated roof view versus 2026 street views; small roof details may have changed.
Full south/east-return and branch-screened north opening schedules remain unverified.
Camera heights, focal lengths and precise distances of most real photos are unknown; new model cameras approximate view class only.
Source images are uncalibrated for material reflectance and color.
Master integration and campus context not inspected.
